Two women are sitting under a large tree outdoors near a calm lakeside in soft daylight. The woman on the left is holding a guitar and playing it continuously, her fingers moving naturally along the strings while her body gently sways with the rhythm. She keeps playing throughout the entire scene and does not speak.

The woman on the right is sitting relaxed beside the tree, facing slightly toward the camera. She looks engaged and expressive, then begins speaking clearly to the viewer. Her lips move naturally in sync as she says: "那个美国人真奇怪，一进门看到我就决着要我嫁给他，所以我只有告诉他，我已经跟三位飞行员结过婚了。一个死。"

While speaking, her facial expression changes slightly to show mild surprise and disbelief. She makes small natural head movements and subtle hand gestures while talking, but her body remains mostly stable.

The left woman continues playing the guitar smoothly without interruption. The right woman continues speaking until the sentence is finished, maintaining clear lip sync and natural expression.

The camera remains stable in a medium full-body shot, capturing both women together. The background stays consistent with the tree, soft light, and calm outdoor environment. No scene changes, no extra people, no sudden movements.
